text.tspan: Effective fertility rate by age of the children Spain
Average number of children per woman who survive to each age, by the year the children were born. For
example, a value of 2.7 at age 20 on the 1975 line means that, at the fertility rate of 1975, women would have
2.7 children each who live to age 20.

tspan.tspan: Malani and Jacob (2024); UN, World Population Prospects (2024); Human Mortality Database (2025)
Before 1950, data is only available for a few countries. Survival after 2023 is based on UN projections.
